info.prompt: A neon-drenched cyber-gothic cathedral pulses with Electric Magenta and Neon Cyan light, its skeletal gold filigree framing a high-stakes gaming interface where translucent dice hover above a Void Black abyss. Neural lattice pathways crackle with synaptic energy between bio-mechanical tiles, each pulsing in anticipation of unlock conditions. Terminal-style hacker text scrolls along the bottom edge, while an oscilloscope heartbeat thrums in sync with the player's actions. Crystalline UI elements fracture open with particle bursts, revealing scoring multipliers in a shower of digital alchemy.
